prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design a watch-face complication for a medication reminder companion. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: watchOS. Proposal displays a full medication name and patient identifier on a shared-visible face, uses tiny multi-line instructions and turns the complication into a scrolling task list. A dose can be due, recorded or overdue.
